SELECT max(try_cast(gen_mw AS double)) AS peak_wind_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix WHERE fuel_category = 'Wind'
Which states have the most electric substations?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_substations WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average day-ahead power price in the Capital zone in 2021?
Nyiso Lmp Day Ahead Hourly Mlbmp Zone
SELECT avg(try_cast(lbmp_mwhr AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_lmp_day_ahead_hourly_mlbmp_zone WHERE name = 'CAPITL' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2021'
Which EPA regions open the most enforcement cases?
SELECT region_code, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_enforcements WHERE region_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many transmission line segments carry 345 kilovolts?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_power_transmission_lines WHERE replace(voltage, '"', '') = '345'
Which states have the most small benefit plans filing the short form?
SELECT sf_spons_us_state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_5500_sf WHERE sf_spons_us_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did public school students break down by race and ethnicity in 2024-25?

SELECT race_ethnicity, sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students, round(100.0 * sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) / sum(sum(try_cast(student_count AS double))) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator LIKE 'Category Set A%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which water systems reported the highest 90th-percentile lead levels in 2023?

SELECT p.pws_name, max(try_cast(s.sample_measure AS double)) AS lead_mg_l FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_lcr_samples AS s JOIN govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems AS p ON p.pwsid = s.pwsid WHERE s.contaminant_code = 'PB90' AND substr(s.sampling_end_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Service Contract Act wage determinations are active today?
SELECT count(DISTINCT wd_number) AS determinations FROM govblock_awards.sam_wage_determinations WHERE kind = 'sca' AND is_active = 'Y'
Which inverter makers are used most often in installed solar systems?

SELECT inverter_manufacturer_1, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE inverter_manufacturer_1 <> '-1' AND inverter_manufacturer_1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

Which Florida cities recorded the most fatal crashes in 2022?
SELECT cityname, count(*) AS crashes FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE statename = 'Florida' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2022' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many planned generators were cancelled before they were built?
Eia860 Generator Y Retired And Canceled
SELECT count(DISTINCT plant_code || '-' || generator_id) AS cancelled FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_retired_and_canceled WHERE status = 'CN'
Which states file the most complaints about unwanted calls?
SELECT state, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_consumer_complaints WHERE issue = 'Unwanted Calls' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many deposited substance records map to caffeine?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_sid WHERE c0 = '2519'
Which reactors averaged the highest output in 2023?
SELECT unit, avg(try_cast(power AS double)) AS avg_power FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_power_status WHERE reportdt LIKE '%/2023 %' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many homes in Detroit stand vacant?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '1600000US2622000' AND variable = 'B25002_E003'
Which kinds of relation link ChEBI entities most often?

SELECT t.description, count(*) AS links FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_relation AS r JOIN govblock_chemistry.chebi_relation_type AS t ON cast(t.id AS varchar) = cast(r.relation_type_id AS varchar) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average WTI spot price across 2008?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(value AS double)), 2) AS dollars_per_barrel FROM govblock_energy.eia_pet_data WHERE series_id = 'PET.RWTC.D' AND period LIKE '2008%'
Which universities received the most NIH funding in fiscal year 2024?
SELECT org_name, sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many pieces of research software are archived in the Zenodo collection?
SELECT count(*) AS records FROM govblock_scholarly.zenodo_records WHERE resource_type_general = 'Software'
Which facilities in Texas released the most toxic chemicals into the air in 2019?

SELECT _4_facility_name, _6_city, sum(try_cast(_51_51_fugitive_air AS double) + try_cast(_52_52_stack_air AS double)) AS air_release FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _8_st = 'TX' AND cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2019' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many public schools are magnet schools?
SELECT count(*) AS magnet_schools FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_129 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND magnet_text = 'Yes'
What was the highest five-minute load in the Hudson Valley zone in 2021?
SELECT max(try_cast(load AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_load_pal WHERE name = 'HUD VL' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2021'
Which states have the lowest share of adults who are citizens?
SELECT geoname, round(100.0 * try_cast(cvap_est AS double) / try_cast(adu_est AS double), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_elections.cvap_state WHERE lntitle = 'Total' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How did the Supreme Court vote in Brown v. Board of Education?
SELECT case_name, date_filed, scdb_votes_majority, scdb_votes_minority FROM govblock_courts.opinion_clusters WHERE case_name LIKE 'Brown v. Board of Education%' LIMIT 5
Which companies received the most U.S. patents in 2023?

SELECT a.disambig_assignee_organization, count(DISTINCT p.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent p JOIN govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated a ON a.patent_id = p.patent_id WHERE p.patent_date LIKE '2023%' AND a.disambig_assignee_organization <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
On average, what share of assets do large multiemployer pension plans hold in stocks?
SELECT avg(try_cast(pen_stock_prcnt AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_r WHERE pen_stock_prcnt IS NOT NULL
Which school districts spent the most money in fiscal 2017?
SELECT name, stabbr, try_cast(totalexp AS double) AS total_spending FROM govblock_education.ccd_sdf WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '17' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal loans were made in fiscal 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_award_search WHERE category = 'loans' AND cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2022'
In which states is energy most expensive per million Btu?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_million_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'SEDS.TETCD.%.A' AND length(series_id) = 15 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) NOT IN ('US', 'X3', 'X5') AND period = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
